ideas.label: Seventh-Rank Invasion
ideas.principle: Invade where pawns and king are vulnerable
ideas.summary: A rook on the seventh rank attacks pawns from the side, restricts the king, and often creates mating or promotion threats.

ideas.label: Seventh-Rank Invasion
ideas.summary: An invasion is strongest when another piece controls the escape squares or a passed pawn distracts the defender. Prepare entry by taking an open file and denying exchanges.
games: Alexander Alekhine vs Jose Raul Capablanca 1927 (E16) [bookwalk]

ideas.label: Seventh-Rank Invasion
ideas.principle: Use king entry and deflection to invade
ideas.summary: In a rook ending, combine a seventh-rank rook with an advancing king that attacks the defender's pawns. If entry is blocked, a pawn sacrifice can open the file or deflect the guarding rook.
